scope: Sargent and Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 1 (Finite States), Chapter 4: Optimal Stopping. Stopping problems (beta, P, c, e), policies and their lifetime values as fixed points of the policy operators, the spectral radius bound rho(L_sigma) < 1, the Bellman operator as a beta-contraction whose unique fixed point is the value function, Bellman's principle of optimality for stopping problems, value function iteration, continuation values and the continuation value operator, monotone values and threshold policies, dimensionality reduction for IID components, firm valuation with exit, finite-horizon American options embedded in infinite-horizon stopping with the exercise region expanding over time, and research and development with constant and IID costs, with the provable exercises.
source: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 1: Finite States, Chapter 4, pp. 105-127.
